title: Adjust for several learners
notice: Use this when one decision covers many learners, for example after the service was unavailable. Allowance balances are not used. You see every learner's new date before anything changes; it then applies to all of them or to none.
kind.outage: Outage (time lost to a service problem; moves a deadline only)
kind.accommodation: Accommodation (an approved need; can also add study minutes)
days.hint: Added to the deadline at this level for each learner.
preview: Show the effect on each learner
effect.count: {count, plural, one {# learner would change} other {# learners would change}}
refused: {count, plural, one {# learner would not change} other {# learners would not change}}
refused.OUTAGE_DEADLINE_ONLY: an outage can only move a deadline.
refused.PARENT_CAP_CONFLICT: a stricter limit above this level would still apply, so the extra days would have no effect. Adjust the higher level instead.
refused.NO_EFFECT: the change would not move this learner's date.
refused.INVALID_CHANGE: this level has no deadline or work limit of that kind for this learner.
refused.UNKNOWN_SCOPE: this learner's course version does not have this part.
refused.ENROLLMENT_INACTIVE: this learner's course is paused or closed.
refused.other: the policy did not allow it for this learner.
reason.hint: For example an incident or approval number. Not health or personal details.
apply: {count, plural, one {Apply to # learner} other {Apply to # learners}}
